title: Persistent VAT credit positions: multi-period pattern and seventh scenario
scope: Cover Challenge 2's persistent VAT credit positions: detect credits that persist across periods, test structural explanations first (zero-rated exports, capital spending), add a seventh synthetic scenario and plant it in a new benchmark seed

acceptance.text: A multi-period check flags persistent credits only after structural explanations are tested and recorded
A seventh synthetic scenario with expected outcome; a legitimate structural credit stays in the fast lane
Measured on a new sealed seed with false positives reported
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR
